truths.truth: A trace written before this phase renders and suggests exactly as it did before - no coordinator key, unchanged counts/roles/unpaired and unchanged suggestion list.
truths.evidence: `node cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs trace render --dir <copy of cadence-core/bin/fixtures/verbatim.trace.jsonl> --phase 1` -> counts {routing:8,provider:0,lifecycle:18,outcome:2}, roles for 5 workers, NO `coordinator` key; `trace suggest` on the same -> exactly the two pre-existing infos (cad-executor 44% share, risk_surface). Pinned as literals: `node --test cadence-core/bin/trace.test.mjs` passes 'fixture: the committed verbatim trace renders exactly as it did before this phase' and 'coordinator: a trace with no marker renders no coordinator block at all' (asserts `'coordinator' in renderTrace(fixtureRoot())` is false). truths.truth: Coordinator markers reach `trace render`'s events[] under the lifecycle family, each naming its step, and no marker carries a tokens field.
truths.evidence: Three markers appended via `trace append --family lifecycle --event coordinator --step {load_priors,spend_gate,analyze}` then rendered: all three appear in events[] with family 'lifecycle', event 'coordinator', a `step` string, and `any tokens: False`. Collected at cadence-core/bin/lib/trace.mjs:462-465 (before the per-role chain, so `roleTotals` is untouched - D-07); seam passes `step` through at cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs:2356. Census pins the prose vocabulary: cadence-core/bin/trace.test.mjs:811 includes COORDINATOR in `known`, :908-917 asserts every written `--event coordinator` site carries no --tokens, no --role and a non-empty --step.

truths.truth: `renderTrace` derives the coordinator's own unbracketed time - wall minus the union of bracket spans, per step, keyed by phase - and `/cad-report`'s and `trace suggest`'s figures come from that one computation.
truths.evidence: cadence-core/bin/lib/trace.mjs:554-600 (per-marker window to the next marker, last window closed by the phase's last event, merged spans clipped, residue floored at 0); surfaced through the seam at cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs:2400-2402 (block omitted entirely when absent). Traced end to end on a constructed trace: 3 markers + one 10-min paired bracket -> `{wall_ms:4800000, bracket_ms:600000, residue_ms:4200000, steps:[load_priors 30min, analyze 20min, write_context 20min]}`, and `trace suggest` on the same trace emitted `coordinator time between worker brackets: 70 min (88% of wall time), most of it at \`load_priors\` (30 min)` - i.e. the reader read the render's figures rather than recomputing. Named tests green: 'coordinator: a step's residue is its wall span minus the bracket inside it', '...two workers running at once subtract their overlap ONCE', '...an UNPAIRED dispatch subtracts nothing', '...a marker with an unparseable ts contributes nothing, never NaN'.

truths.truth: `trace suggest` returns a coordinator-spend suggestion above its residue floor and stays silent below it / on an empty render.
truths.evidence: R6 at cadence-core/bin/lib/trace-suggest.mjs:188-224, floor at :35. Above floor: the 70-min run above returns the `coordinator` info. Below floor: a 44-ms marker trace's suggest returns no coordinator entry. Empty case pinned by deep-equality at cadence-core/bin/trace-suggest.test.mjs:136 (`suggestFromRender(render([]))` deepEqual `[]`); `node --test cadence-core/bin/trace-suggest.test.mjs` green.

truths.truth: `trace append --step` refuses a bare or blank value AND refuses --step alongside --tokens or --role.
truths.evidence: Bare and blank are refused: both `--step` and `--step "   "` return `{"ok":false,"reason":"bad-args",...}` (cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs:2324-2328). The combination is NOT refused: `trace append --phase 1 --family lifecycle --event coordinator --step load_priors --tokens 999` returned `{"ok":true,"written":true}` and wrote `{"...","event":"coordinator","tokens":999,"step":"load_priors"}`; `--step analyze --role cad-planner` likewise wrote `"role":"cad-planner"`. cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs:2331-2338 states the choice explicitly: the rule is 'held by the prose that writes it and by the census assertion in trace.test.mjs, never by a runtime refusal keyed to an event name'.

truths.truth: `<step name="spend_gate">` sits between `load_priors` and `analyze` in `cadence-core/workflows/context.md`, ahead of the `--bracket-read` resolve, and that ordering is pinned by a test that actually fails when it moves.
truths.evidence: Step offsets in cadence-core/workflows/context.md: load_priors:57, spend_gate:86, analyze:155, the analyzer `--bracket-read` at 163-165. Pinned at cadence-core/bin/prose-agreement.test.mjs:373-408, reading the gate's step name off the deferred-read register rather than hardcoding it. Falsified live on a scratch copy of the repo: moving the whole spend_gate block below the analyze step and running `node --test --test-name-pattern "spend gate precedes the resolve"` -> `AssertionError: context.md opens the spend_gate step BELOW <step name="analyze">`. `load_priors` reads prior SUMMARY deviations (8df2a1f) and the recall read is anchored on `spend_gate` in `cadence-core/bin/lib/deferred-reads.mjs` (deferred-reads.test.mjs green).

The rendered LINE is prose composed by a walked `/cad-report` run (D-05), which no probe here executes.

truths.truth: Answering the gate "skip" still produces `.planning/phases/<N>/CONTEXT.md` with no `lifecycle/dispatch` and no `routing/resolve` for `cad-assumptions-analyzer` in the trace.

The outcome - a CONTEXT.md actually written on that arm - is behavior of an interactive workflow run, and CONTEXT D-13 records that the skip arm ships with no positive fixture evidence.

gaps.name: trace append --step refuses bare/blank and --tokens/--role
gaps.reason: behavior wrong - only half the item is delivered. Bare and blank `--step` are refused as `bad-args`, but `--step` alongside `--tokens` or `--role` is accepted and written. SUMMARY.md:13 and its Goal check (SUMMARY.md:62) both state the marker is 'refused alongside `--tokens`/`--role`' at the seam; the seam does no such refusal.
gaps.evidence: cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs:2324-2328 refuses bare/blank only; :2331-2338 states the combination rule is deliberately NOT enforced at runtime. Observed: `node cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs trace append --dir <scratch>/.planning --phase 1 --family lifecycle --event coordinator --step load_priors --tokens 999` -> `{"ok":true,"written":true,"corr":"1"}` and the line written is `{"corr":"1","phase":"1","ts":"...","family":"lifecycle","event":"coordinator","tokens":999,"step":"load_priors"}`; the `--role cad-planner` variant likewise wrote `"role":"cad-planner"` onto a coordinator marker. The only defense is the prose census (cadence-core/bin/trace.test.mjs:908-917), which scans WRITTEN workflow prose and cannot see a hand-made or foreign-producer append.
gaps.missing: Either (a) add the runtime refusal the item and SUMMARY claim - in the `trace append` arg handling, fail `bad-args` when `step` is present together with `tokens` or a non-empty `role` (a single guard beside planning.mjs:2324-2328), and cover it with a seam test; or (b) if the event-agnostic seam is the standing decision, correct SUMMARY.md:13 and SUMMARY.md:62 to say the rule is held by prose + census only, and restate UAT item 8's expectation to match. Do not leave the claim and the code disagreeing.

human_checks.name: Walk `/cad-report <N>` on a phase whose trace carries coordinator markers, then on a phase whose trace predates this phase
human_checks.expected: The `Record health:` line names a coordinator residue in minutes plus the step carrying the most of it on the first; on the second it mentions no residue at all.
human_checks.why_human: The record-health line is prose composed by the coordinator at run time from the render block (D-05, report.md:45-59) - there is no seam that emits it, so no command available here produces the line. It requires a live `/cad-report` slash-command run in an installed Cadence session, which is outside this agent's reach.

human_checks.name: Walk `/cad-context <N>` on a small phase and answer the Analyzer question "Skip it"
human_checks.expected: `.planning/phases/<N>/CONTEXT.md` is written anyway, and `planning.mjs trace render --phase <N>` shows no `lifecycle/dispatch` and no `routing/resolve` naming `cad-assumptions-analyzer` for that phase.
human_checks.why_human: The gate is an interactive ask-user question inside a slash-command workflow; the skip arm's outcome only exists once a human answers it in a live session. No fixture exercises it (D-13 records the skip arm ships with no positive evidence), and this agent cannot run the workflow or answer its prompt.

human_checks.name: Walk `/cad-context 2` in /data/code/verbatim and read the Analyzer question's annotation
human_checks.expected: The annotation presents six named surfaces as its evidence, and the recommended (first) option is "Dispatch it", not "Skip it".
human_checks.why_human: Both the surface count and the recommendation are the coordinator's judgment at run time (D-11: no score, no threshold, nothing computed), so no code path determines them and no probe can observe them without a live `/cad-context` run.
